components.name: Default action
components.description: Dashboard primary action; source tokens inherit from the dashboard theme.

components.name: Outline action
components.description: Dark outline variant, with the input foreground/background roles kept distinct.
components.css: .ds-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);font:500 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui);background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--input) 30%,transparent);color:var(--foreground);border:1px solid var(--input);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05)}.ds-outline:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--input) 50%,transparent)}.ds-control:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent)}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Semantic input stroke, dark input fill, muted placeholder and visible focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-control ds-input" aria-label="Note title" placeholder="Note title" />
components.css: .ds-input{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:44px;padding:4px 12px;border:1px solid var(--input);border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--input) 30%,transparent);color:var(--foreground);font:400 16px/1.4 var(--font-ui);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-control:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent)}

components.name: Sidebar link
